scope: Normalize model-list envelopes and token-limit metadata for custom OpenAI-compatible gateways

formats.token_values: positive integers or exact integer strings; fractions, negatives, ambiguous units, booleans and overflow stay unknown
formats.output_separation: output-only limit never establishes the context window
formats.bounds: existing response byte/time/redirect limits retained; at most 5000 normalized records and 3 envelope levels

photo_shape.wire_id: outer gateway alias preserved; nested upstream id does not replace it
photo_shape.gateway_ui_capabilities: not interpreted as model tool/vision support or Opcode permission grants

regressions: Local and OpenAI discovery backends accept the same custom gateway envelopes
Native provider authentication, model filtering and pagination tests remain passing
LM Studio loaded-context and native Ollama metadata precedence remain passing
Named profiles propagate 131072 through model selection
Positive manual context overrides still take precedence
No reported output limit is reused as context
Invalid numeric metadata does not invent a limit
Unrecognized error objects and excessive nesting fail without exposing body contents

live.provider: local Ollama and loopback catalog fixture

limits: Compatibility is based on documented explicit envelopes/field aliases, not arbitrary recursive schema guessing
Manual positive contextWindow settings continue to override discovery
Only sanitized fixtures based on the photos were tested for the corporate response; the private corporate endpoint was not contacted
